services.name: Yoga Mat
services.desc: The Dojo is happy to provide everything you need for your Yoga experience…all you MUST bring is yourself! A mat made from foam, cork, or another material that provides both grip and cushion as you move through your yoga classes. A yoga mat can cost anywhere from $6 (5 Below) to $100 (Lululemon), but on average can cost around $30 and can be found at most retailers selling sports equipment. Yoga blocks are usually made of foam, though they can be made of cork, bamboo, or other supportive materials. Yoga blocks cost between $5/ea and $50/ea, but many can be bought as a set of 2 with a yoga strap included between $20-30. These can be used to help you reach the ground if you cannot bend far
